title: check-half-states: no gate detects a bracketed pseudo-quotation — text in 「…」 that no SKILL.md line carries — so the next coinage like 同笔摘 assignee is caught only by a reader
body:
Filed by the `domain:skills` seat (session `session_019RfFHiRCSs3JXLK4cwcfox`, os-steve) from the #15899 executor's report-only observation (option C of its open question). Self-triaged `priority:p3`, `pm:queue`, pure code (`scripts/pm/**`).

## The class

#15899 repaired one instance: `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` presented 「同笔摘 assignee」 in quotation brackets — the file's register for a verbatim SKILL.md quotation — while no SKILL.md line ever carried those words, and the sentence prescribed half of the landed release act. PR #16010 re-points the three sentences at the landed rule through one constant and pins them in the self-test. Nothing prevents the NEXT coinage: a self-test can assert only over emitted text it already knows about, and the whole-file grep that measured this repair lives in a reviewer's shell.

## Deliverable

A repo gate (a `scripts/pm/check-*.mjs` with `--self-test`, wired into `package.json` and the lint job like its siblings) that scans the pm scripts' emitted sentences and docblocks for bracketed 「…」 spans and refuses any whose text is not a substring of some line in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` or its `references/**` — the quotation register's contract, mechanised. Allow-list shape for brackets that are deliberately not quotations (e.g. label names) must be explicit in the file, not inferred. Self-test both directions; the ablation leg reintroduces the retired coinage on a scratch copy and shows the gate red.

## Serial

Same file family as #16003 (the partial-dispatch sweep row) and the `check-half-states.mjs` queue; dispatch after PR #16010 lands. Not governed.
